description: Completion choices and existing effort faces (REQ-010; C29, C30; R63, R76, R78, R80, R86, R87, R116, R124) delivered through the accepted shared owner TimedResultLog (src/ui/refinements/timed-result-log.tsx: its For Time and ladder families — Work completed with Complete beside Incomplete in one row under the accepted .clr-timed-completion recipe, then the existing three-face effort), the design system's ChoiceGroup and the existing effort control SetEffortChoice (src/ui/set-effort.tsx, the accepted owner's narrow scope/legend adaptation only), composed by the route consumers ForTimeBlock (src/ui/for-time-block.tsx; the completion answer starts at Complete after Finish under the cap and Incomplete at the cap, is kept on the race's own record and saved as completed_under_cap; stopping mid-race claims nothing) and LadderBlock (src/ui/ladder-block.tsx; with nothing tracked, Finish, the cap and a schedule run out start at Incomplete with no rung, and only the athlete's Complete records the top rung), on the real /workout route (JOURNEY-010) through the section save, a reload, a failed save and its retry, and the History read, and the accepted gallery states /gallery/refinements?state=for_time and ?state=ladder (reference eded158cfd928d382c9a9409e2c372270312741d). Effort stays optional and null when unanswered, and is never written as the numeric perceived_effort or a session mood. Every declared case must execute and pass.

check-01.command: node scripts/refinement/run-required-check.mjs --task TASK-010 --check check-01 -- npx vitest run src/ui/timed-result-log.test.tsx --testNamePattern "completion|effort" --passWithNoTests=false

cases.name: TASK-010 completion choices and existing effort faces > AC-C29-01 Complete and Incomplete share one row in the For Time and ladder logs on the real /workout route: one Work completed question, two equal answers side by side under the accepted recipe, after the work

TASK-010 completion choices and existing effort faces > AC-R010-01 For Time completion starts where the race ended — Finish under the cap at Complete, the cap at Incomplete — stopping mid-race or with no cap claims nothing, and the athlete corrects either way

TASK-010 completion choices and existing effort faces > AC-R010-01 ladder completion follows the work it tracked: nothing is chosen before the attempt ends; Finish, the cap and a schedule run out, with nothing tracked, start at Incomplete with no rung — never every rung — and only the athlete’s Complete records the top rung

TASK-010 completion choices and existing effort faces > AC-R010-01 completion end to end: the stored answer, a reload, the saved block results, a return to the saved section and History keep Complete and Incomplete apart

TASK-010 completion choices and existing effort faces > AC-C30-01 effort is optional and unanswered stays null: the existing three faces with no default, Clear back to null, and never a numeric block effort or a session mood

TASK-010 completion choices and existing effort faces > AC-R010-02 effort reuses Frown, Meh and Smile with their established words, order, categories, selected tick, focus and keyboard behaviour: no new icon, scale or wording
TASK-010 completion choices and existing effort faces > AC-R010-01 a failed save keeps the completion answer and the effort on screen, and the retry writes the same completion once with no effort

TASK-010 completion choices and existing effort faces > AC-R010-01 For Time records written before the completion question load and read as before: a finish reads Complete and a cap Incomplete, the same completed_under_cap they always saved, and nothing is rewritten

TASK-010 completion choices and existing effort faces > JOURNEY-010 the accepted for_time and ladder gallery states draw the route’s own logs: completion at the route’s starting point, the existing effort faces unanswered, live over memory only

check-02.command: node scripts/refinement/run-required-check.mjs --task TASK-010 --check check-02 -- npx playwright test e2e/refinement/task-010.spec.ts --project=mobile
